text_block_list.text:
"It happened when Sweep Tosho and I
were passing through the shopping district—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What could that be?
Are they lining up for something...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
How about testing your luck to see what you win?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a lottery! That looks pretty fun!
Familiar, we're doing that!
choice_data_list: Still, we don't have any raffle tickets.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have any, just go get some!
Buy whatever you want!
Sweets, clothes, katsu curry, anything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just let me spin the raffle!
I'm not going home until I spin it!

Just as Sweep Tosho pleaded,
I did some shopping and got a raffle ticket!
Naturally, out of my own pocket!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright, here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Clover☆ Clover☆ Cloooveeeer~!
Magic of good fortune, lend me your power!

After chanting a magic spell,
Sweep Tosho vigorously cranked the raffle wheel.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Y—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize! It's the grand prize!
Meaning it's the absolute best one, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right, right?!
After all, I'm the great and invincible
Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A great magical girl is broad-minded, so I'll give the ticket to you. Come on, let's head back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Because an onsen just sounds boring. A big bath sounds fun, but the academy's is plenty big already."
I ended up getting a hot springs trip ticket...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! In exchange for giving you that,
take me to an amusement park!
And the zoo, and strawberry picking, and...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"After all, it's the grand prize,
so it's bound to be worth at least that much!"
choice_data_list: Then whenever it's convenient for you...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Well, can't be helped. Besides, it's not like I don't have other things to do."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mastering the magic of racing completely
and blowing everyone away comes first!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You'll return the favor for the grand prize
once that's all done!
A promise magic so you won't forget!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Bridge pledge anagallis!
This promise can never, ever be broken!

She had things she wanted to do first.
Hearing her say that made me happy.

Once she accomplishes her big goal,
I want to celebrate with her to the fullest—
this travel voucher is a token of that promise.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wow, doesn't that look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Today's dinner is decided with this!
Familiar, hurry up and get it ready!"

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
How about some veggies on the side?
I've got some exceptionally tasty green peppers today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I don't want it, I don't want it, I don't want it!!
The Salisbury steak alone is already delicious enough!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, let's hurry home and eat!
Come on, chop chop!"

Practically dragged along by Sweep Tosho,
I returned to the academy and ended up
cooking hamburger steaks in my room's kitchen...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hey!!
Why are there bell peppers on the side?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course I wouldn't want it even if there's extra!
That would turn my hard-earned first prize into a punishment game!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Honestly, here, you can have the bell peppers. It's your reward for making Salisbury steak, so take it gratefully.

Sweep Tosho diligently passed all her bell peppers over to me,
but she seemed thoroughly delighted with the delicious hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Second prize! That's pretty amazing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, what exactly is this
'heaping carrot dish' like—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kya!? Th-That's an insane amount...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, even for an Umamusume,
finishing all this might be tough.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!?
I can totally eat it all by myself!?
Don't underestimate Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I can eat it!
Even if you want some, I'm not sharing with you!"
And so, Sweep Tosho triumphantly brought home a mountain of carrots, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I'm bored. Boooored out of my mind!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want this anymore! I wanna eat something else!
Familiar~! Do something about it~!"

I can finish it all, but I'll get sick of it...!
As I racked my brain over what to do—inspiration struck!
choice_data_list: Let's cast a spell to turn the carrots into sweets!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magic that turns carrots into sweets...?
What's that? That actually sounds kind of fun!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ready, set—

text_block_list.name: Trainer & Sweep
text_block_list.text: Cook☆Confect☆Cook!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I did it!
Special carrot parfait, ready to serve~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I kind of feel like this is just cooking
instead of magic, though..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, it was fun anyway!
I'll even spare a bite for my familiar!"

I breathe a sigh of relief seeing Sweep Tosho in a great mood.
It seems she was thoroughly satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez! Why isn't it the Grand Prize?! I chanted the magic spell and everything!
choice_data_list: But they look like delicious carrots!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it,
it really is a deep, glossy orange...
(Crunch... munch, munch...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's delicious...?!?!?
What is this?! It's so good!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I see! Thanks to magic,
I managed to pick the tastiest carrot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! There's no doubt about it,
I really am a genius magical girl!

Sweep Tosho seemed delighted.
Breathing an inward sigh of relief,
we headed back together...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A-A miss~?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"That can't be right!
I cast a good luck spell properly!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, no, no, no! I'm drawing again!
Familiar, go get more raffle tickets, quickly!
There's no way my magic failed—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A... Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez! I didn't win the raffle, it's freezing, I can't stop sneezing... what gives?! *Achoo!*

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If that's how it's gonna be, I'll use every last
tissue I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Diiiing!)
Under the chilly sky, Sweep Tosho blew her nose, taking out her frustration on the tissues...
